answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The meadow edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 171 clones produces a signature the saffron analysis flags immediately. Someone must thus build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the onyx settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 15 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
